title: 3D culture of multipotent Sox9<sup>+</sup> mouse embryonic lung progenitors: Isolation, Expansion and Cryopreservation
protocol: Set the water bath to 37°C.
Disinfect the laminar flow hood, Binocular Stereo Microscope, and dissection instruments with 70% ethanol.
UV sterilize the equipment for 30 minutes.
Mate Sox9^GFP (or Wild-Type) male and female mice.
Check for vaginal plugs the following morning to determine gestational day E0.5.
Euthanize the E12.5 pregnant female mouse in the CO2 chamber.
Spray ethanol 70% on the abdomen of the pregnant female.
Make a small incision over the belly skin.
Enlarge the incision and pull out the uterine horn containing the string of embryos.
Transfer the uterine horns to a 50 mL tube filled with ice-cold DPBS on ice.
Rinse the uterine horns quickly with sterile ethanol 100%.
Rinse the uterine horns twice with DPBS.
Transfer uterine horns in a tissue culture dish with sterile pre-cooled (4°C) Phenol red-free Leibovitz L-15.
Dissect embryos out of the uterus under a stereomicroscope.
Remove all membranes and placenta from the embryos.
Transfer cleaned embryo to a new tissue culture dish with sterile pre-cooled (4°C) Phenol red-free Leibovitz L-15 on ice.
Flip E12.5 embryos laterally.
Tear the thoracic cage of E12.5 embryos.
Open up until embryonic heart is visible.
Gently remove internal organs from abdomen without disturbing heart and lungs.
Pull out heart and lungs by grabbing both heart and larynx.
Transfer heart and lungs to a new tissue culture dish with sterile pre-cooled (4°C) Phenol red-free Leibovitz L-15 on ice.
Gently remove heart, esophagus, and trachea.
Pool E12.5 embryonic lungs into a 15 mL tube containing 5 mL of dissociation buffer.
Incubate at 37°C (under shaking) for 20-30 minutes with frequent trituration every 10 minutes until the embryonic lungs are fully dissociated.
Wash the cells with 5 mL of collection buffer.
Filter through a 100 μm cell strainer.
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 2000 rpm (4°C).
Remove the supernatant and gently tap to dislodge the pellet.
Re-suspend in pre-warmed (37°C) suspension buffer (3 mL).
Filter again through a 40 μm cell strainer.
Transfer the filtrate into 2 sterile low-bind 1.5 mL tubes.
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 2000 rpm (4°C).
Remove supernatant and wash pellet with 1 mL FACS buffer.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 2000 rpm (4°C).
Remove supernatant and resuspend the pellet with 200 μL of FACS buffer until full dissociation.
Incubate cells for 10 minutes at room temperature (RT).
Add 1 µL of each antibody (anti-Cdh1, anti-Pecam1/CD31, anti-Ptprc/CD45 and anti-Ter119 eFluor-conjugated; dilution 1:200) directly into the 1.5 mL tubes.
Incubate with primary antibodies for 30 minutes at 4°C under gentle shaking.
Add immediately 1 mL of ice-cold FACS buffer to each tube.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 2000 rpm (4°C).
Remove the supernatant without dislodging the pellet and resuspend the cells with 400-500 µL of suspension buffer + DAPI (0.1 µg/mL).
Set the gating strategy according to Fig. 1.
Collect cells in a 1.5 mL low-bind tube containing 400 µL of post-sorting collection buffer.
Perform sorting on a BD FACS Aria II cytometer or higher version.
Ensure post-sort purity is ≥90%.
Add 1 mL of ice-cold suspension buffer after sorting and aliquot 1000 cells per low-bind 1.5 mL tube.
Centrifuge at 2000 rpm for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant without dislodging the pellet using a p200 pipette.
Keep tubes on ice.
Embed cells in 45 µL of ice-cold Growth Factor Reduced, Phenol Red-Free Matrigel (10mg/mL).
Resuspend cells by pipetting up and down with a p200 pipette and replace the tube on ice.
Dispense a 40 µL drop carefully onto the center of the growth area of wells in a 24-well culture plate, avoiding bubbles.
Place the culture plate in a 37°C incubator for 20 minutes to allow the Matrigel to solidify.
Add gently 500 µL of LPM3D medium to each well on the inner wall and not directly on the Matrigel droplet.
Replace the medium every 2 days starting from day 1. Colonies should be visible from day 3-4 onwards (Fig. 2).
Remove the culture medium without disturbing the Matrigel drop containing the cells.
Add 200 µL of pre-warmed dissociation buffer for passaging.
Pipette up and down in the well until the Matrigel drop is fragmented with the p200.
Transfer the plate to the incubator and incubate for 30 minutes.
Incubate for an additional 30 minutes.
Check under the microscope that the colonies are fully dissociated into single cells.
Add 1 mL of advanced DMEM/F12, mix well, and transfer the contents of the well into a 15 mL tube.
Add another 1 mL of advanced DMEM/F12 to rinse the well and transfer to the same 15 mL tube.
Count the cells with a hemocytometer.
Transfer 2000 cells into a new 15 mL tube.
Centrifuge at 300g for 10 minutes at 4°C to pellet the cells.
Remove the supernatant without disturbing the cell pellet.
Gently tap the 15 mL tube to dislodge the pellet and keep cells on ice.
Add 45 μL of ice-cold Growth Factor Reduced, Phenol Red-Free Matrigel (10 mg/mL) to the pellet with the p200.
Gently pipette up and down until the cells are fully resuspended and replace the tube on ice.
Dispense a 40 µL drop carefully onto the center of the growth area of wells in a 24-well culture plate, avoiding bubbles.
Place the culture plate in the incubator for 20 minutes to allow the Matrigel to solidify.
Add gently 500 µL of LPM3D medium to each well.
Dispense medium on the inner wall of the well and not directly on the Matrigel drop.
Replace medium every 2 days.
Passage every 10-12 days as appropriate.
Remove the culture medium and dissociate the Matrigel drop as described above.
Add 1 mL of advanced DMEM/F12, mix, and transfer the contents of the well into a 15 mL tube.
Add another 1 mL of advanced DMEM/F12 to rinse the well and transfer to the same 15 mL tube.
Centrifuge at 300g for 10 minutes at 4°C to pellet.
Remove the supernatant without disturbing the cell pellet.
Add 1 mL freezing medium to the 15 mL tube with gentle mixing and transfer contents to labelled cryovials on ice.
Transfer immediately to a “Mr. Frosty” cryopreservation canister at -80°C overnight, then to liquid nitrogen for long-term storage.
Thaw frozen cells in a 37°C water bath.
Wash thawed cells with 10 mL of Advanced DMEM/F12 and then pellet them.
Embed pelleted cells in Matrigel and culture as described above.
